_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Raptor's own, after its FTB and CurseForge eggs.
name: Minecraft: Technic
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Any Technic Platform modpack, such as Tekkit, Hexxit or The 1.12.2 Pack, by its name and build. Installs the pack's official server download with the Minecraft version and Java it needs, and keeps your worlds and the files you change across updates.
startup: read -r need max 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; read -r launch 2>/dev/null < .raptor-launch || { echo "The modpack isn't installed. Reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" -v max="$max" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; low = have + 0 < need + 0; high = max != "" && have + 0 > max + 0; if (low || high) { want = (max == "") ? need " or newer" : (max == need) ? need : need " to " max; printf "This modpack needs Java %s, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", want, have, low ? need : max; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dfml.queryResult=confirm -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true $launch nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Technic. Installs a Technic Platform modpack from its official
# server download: the build you choose (the recommended one by default),
# with the Minecraft version, mod loader and Java it needs. Files you've
# changed and your worlds are kept; files the pack drops on an update are
# removed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
sum() { "${1}sum" "$2" | cut -d' ' -f1; }
older() { [ "$1" != "$2" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n1)" = "$1" ]; }

# Everything new is put together in .raptor-stage first and only moved
# into place once all of it has downloaded and checked out.
stage=/mnt/server/.raptor-stage
rm -rf "$stage" /mnt/server/.raptor-jre
mkdir -p "$stage/files"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage" /mnt/server/.raptor-jre' EXIT
trap 'echo "The install stopped at line $LINENO of its script. Nothing more was changed. Reinstall to try again."' ERR

# ---- The pack, from Technic. ----
# The slug is the name in the pack's link: technicpack.net/modpack/<slug>.<number>.
slug=${TECHNIC_PACK:-}
slug=${slug%%\?*}
slug=${slug%/}
slug=${slug##*/modpack/}
slug=${slug##*/}
[[ "$slug" =~ ^(.+)\.[0-9]+$ ]] && slug=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
slug=$(tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' <<<"$slug")
[[ "$slug" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || fail "Set Modpack to the pack's name from its link on Technic's site (tekkit for technicpack.net/modpack/tekkit.552560), then reinstall."
want=${TECHNIC_VERSION:-recommended}
want=${want:-recommended}

# The launcher build number only tells the API which fields to send.
pack=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://api.technicpack.net/modpack/$slug?build=999" 2>/dev/null) || pack=""
[ -n "$pack" ] && [ -n "$(jq -r '.name // empty' <<<"$pack" 2>/dev/null)" ] ||
    fail "Technic has no modpack called $slug, or can't be reached right now. Check Modpack (the name in the pack's link) and reinstall."
name=$(jq -r '.displayName // .name' <<<"$pack")
server_url=$(jq -r '.serverPackUrl // empty' <<<"$pack")
[ -n "$server_url" ] || fail "$name has no server download on Technic, so it can't be run as a server. Ask its author to publish one."
solder=$(jq -r '.solder // empty' <<<"$pack")
solder=${solder%/}

# The builds, from the pack's Solder (Technic's build list), when it has one.
builds="" recommended="" latest="" info=""
if [ -n "$solder" ]; then
    info=$(get "$solder/modpack/$slug" 2>/dev/null) || info=""
    if [ -n "$info" ] && [ -n "$(jq -r '.builds // empty | .[0] // empty' <<<"$info" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        builds=$(jq -r '.builds[]' <<<"$info")
        recommended=$(jq -r '.recommended // empty' <<<"$info")
        latest=$(jq -r '.latest // empty' <<<"$info")
    fi
fi

# The build the server download is for: the build named in its file name.
file=${server_url%%\?*}
file=${file##*/}
file=${file%.zip}
base=""
while IFS= read -r b; do
    [ -n "$b" ] || continue
    if [[ "$file" =~ (^|[^0-9.])"$b"($|[^0-9A-Za-z.]) ]] && [ "${#b}" -gt "${#base}" ]; then base=$b; fi
done <<<"$builds"
if [ -z "$base" ] && [[ "$file" =~ ([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+[a-z]?) ]]; then base=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; fi
# Otherwise, the version the pack's page shows.
[ -n "$base" ] || [ -n "$builds" ] || base=$(jq -r '.version // empty' <<<"$pack")

case "$want" in
    recommended) build=${base:-$recommended} url=$server_url ;;
    latest)
        build=${latest:-$base}
        [ -n "$build" ] || fail "Technic doesn't say which build of $name is the latest. Set Version to recommended."
        url="" ;;
    *)
        build=$want url=""
        if [ -n "$builds" ] && ! grep -qxF -- "$want" <<<"$builds"; then
            fail "$name has no build $want. Set Version to recommended, latest, or one of its builds, such as ${recommended:-$base}."
        fi ;;
esac
if [ -z "$url" ]; then
    if [ "$build" = "$base" ]; then
        url=$server_url
    elif [ -n "$base" ] && [ "${file/"$base"/}" != "$file" ] && [[ "$server_url" == https://servers.technicpack.net/* ]]; then
        # Technic keeps older builds' server downloads next to the current one.
        url="${server_url%/*}/${file/"$base"/"$build"}.zip"
        curl -fsSIL --retry 2 -A "$ua" -o /dev/null "${url// /%20}" 2>/dev/null || url=""
    fi
    [ -n "$url" ] || fail "Technic has no server download for $name $build. Its server download is for ${base:-the recommended build}; set Version to recommended${base:+ or $base}."
fi
version=${build:-$file}

# Same download as last time, with its mods, libraries and server jar
# still as the pack has them: nothing to do. (Configs aren't checked: some
# mods rename or remove their own when they start.)
skip=0
prev_launch=""
read -r prev_launch 2>/dev/null < .raptor-launch || true
if [ -f .raptor-technic ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-technic)" = "$url" ] && [ -f .raptor-pack ] && [ -n "$prev_launch" ]; then
    skip=1
    start=${prev_launch#-jar }
    start=${start##*@}
    [ -f "$start" ] || skip=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        [ "$skip" = 1 ] || break
        rel=${line:42}
        case "$rel" in
            mods/*|coremods/*|lib/*|libraries/*|"$start")
                [ -f "$rel" ] && [ "$(sum sha1 "$rel")" = "${line:0:40}" ] || skip=0 ;;
        esac
    done < .raptor-pack
fi
if [ "$skip" = 1 ]; then
    echo "$name $version is already installed. Delete .raptor-technic and reinstall to download it again."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Downloading $name $version"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$stage/pack.zip" "${url// /%20}" || true
[ -s "$stage/pack.zip" ] && unzip -tqq "$stage/pack.zip" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    fail "$name's server download didn't arrive complete. Nothing was changed. Reinstall to try again."
# Every path must stay inside the server folder.
if unzip -Z1 "$stage/pack.zip" | grep -E '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)|^/' >/dev/null; then
    fail "$name's server download has files outside the server folder, so it wasn't installed."
fi
unzip -qo "$stage/pack.zip" -d "$stage/files"
rm -f "$stage/pack.zip"
# A download that's one folder with everything in it: use what's inside.
src="$stage/files"
while [ "$(find "$src" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 | wc -l)" = 1 ] && [ -d "$(find "$src" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)" ]; do
    src=$(find "$src" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)
done
if [ "$src" != "$stage/files" ]; then
    mv "$src" "$stage/inner"
    rm -rf "$stage/files"
    mv "$stage/inner" "$stage/files"
fi
cd "$stage/files"
rm -rf eula.txt __MACOSX .DS_Store options.txt servers.dat resourcepacks shaderpacks
find . -name '._*' -type f -delete

# ---- The Minecraft version and loader. ----
mc=""
[ -z "$solder" ] || mc=$(get "$solder/modpack/$slug/$version" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.minecraft // empty' 2>/dev/null) || mc=""
for f in minecraft_server.*.jar forge-*.jar fabric-server-mc.*.jar; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    if [[ "$f" =~ ^(minecraft_server\.|forge-|fabric-server-mc\.)(1\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)[-.] ]]; then mc=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}; break; fi
done
[ -n "$mc" ] || mc=$(jq -r '.minecraft // empty' <<<"$pack")
[ -n "$mc" ] || fail "$name doesn't say which Minecraft version it's for, so it can't be installed."

loader=other
if compgen -G 'libraries/net/neoforged/*' >/dev/null; then loader=neoforge
elif [ -f fabric-server-launch.jar ] || compgen -G 'fabric-server-*.jar' >/dev/null || compgen -G 'libraries/net/fabricmc/*' >/dev/null; then loader=fabric
elif [ -f quilt-server-launch.jar ]; then loader=quilt
elif compgen -G 'forge*.jar' >/dev/null || compgen -G 'libraries/net/minecraftforge/*' >/dev/null || [ -d coremods ] || [ -d mods ]; then loader=forge
fi
case "$loader" in
    forge) Loader=Forge ;; neoforge) Loader=NeoForge ;; fabric) Loader=Fabric ;; quilt) Loader=Quilt ;; *) Loader="its own server" ;;
esac

manifest=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json) || fail "Mojang can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
mc_url=$(jq -r --arg v "$mc" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url' <<<"$manifest")
mc_json=""
need=8
if [ -n "$mc_url" ]; then
    mc_json=$(get "$mc_url") || fail "Mojang can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    need=$(jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' <<<"$mc_json")
fi
# Older modded servers run only on the Java they were made for.
max=""
if [ "$loader" != fabric ] && [ "$loader" != quilt ]; then
    if older "$mc" 1.17; then max=8; elif older "$mc" 1.20.5; then max=21; fi
fi

# A Java to run a loader installer with, removed afterwards.
jre() {
    local a info link sha j=$need
    [ "$j" != 16 ] || j=17
    case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=aarch64 ;; *) fail "This CPU isn't supported." ;; esac
    info=$(get "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/$j/hotspot?architecture=$a&image_type=jre&os=linux&vendor=eclipse") || fail "Adoptium can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    link=$(jq -r '.[0].binary.package.link // empty' <<<"$info")
    sha=$(jq -r '.[0].binary.package.checksum // empty' <<<"$info")
    [ -n "$link" ] || fail "There's no Java $j download for this CPU."
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/.raptor-jre
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$stage/jre.tgz" "$link"
    [ "$(sum sha256 "$stage/jre.tgz")" = "$sha" ] || fail "The Java download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$stage/jre.tgz" -C /mnt/server/.raptor-jre --strip-components=1
    rm -f "$stage/jre.tgz"
    java=/mnt/server/.raptor-jre/bin/java
}
# vanilla <file>: Mojang's server jar for $mc, checked, when it's missing.
vanilla() {
    local url sha
    [ ! -f "$1" ] && [ -n "$mc_json" ] || return 0
    url=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.url // empty' <<<"$mc_json")
    sha=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.sha1 // empty' <<<"$mc_json")
    [ -n "$url" ] || return 0
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$1.new" "$url"
    [ "$(sum sha1 "$1.new")" = "$sha" ] || { rm -f "$1.new"; fail "Minecraft's server jar didn't match Mojang's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$1.new" "$1"
}

# ---- How the pack starts. ----
# unix_args.txt (newer Forge and NeoForge), else the jar its own launch
# script runs, else the loader's jar.
launch=""
args=$(find libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge libraries/net/neoforged -name unix_args.txt 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n1 || true)
[ -z "$args" ] || launch="@user_jvm_args.txt @$args"
if [ -z "$launch" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r j; do
        j=${j#./}
        case "$j" in *installer*) continue ;; esac
        if [ -f "$j" ]; then launch="-jar $j"; break; fi
    done < <(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.bat' -o -name '*.cmd' \) -print0 | sort -z |
        xargs -0 -r grep -ohaE -- '-jar +"?[^" ]+\.jar' | sed -E 's/^-jar +"?//' || true)
fi
if [ -z "$launch" ]; then
    for j in fabric-server-launch.jar fabric-server-mc.*.jar quilt-server-launch.jar forge-*universal*.jar forge-*.jar; do
        case "$j" in *installer*) continue ;; esac
        if [ -f "$j" ]; then launch="-jar $j"; break; fi
    done
fi
# A pack that ships only the loader's installer: run it.
if [ -z "$launch" ]; then
    inst=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*installer*.jar' | head -n1)
    if [ -n "$inst" ]; then
        echo "Running $Loader's installer"
        older "$mc" 1.17 && vanilla "minecraft_server.$mc.jar"
        jre
        "$java" -jar "$inst" --installServer > "$stage/loader.log" 2>&1 ||
            { tail -n 20 "$stage/loader.log"; fail "The pack's loader installer failed (above)."; }
        rm -f "$inst" ./*installer*.log run.bat
        args=$(find libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge libraries/net/neoforged -name unix_args.txt 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n1 || true)
        if [ -n "$args" ]; then
            launch="@user_jvm_args.txt @$args"
        else
            for j in forge-*universal*.jar forge-*.jar; do
                case "$j" in *installer*) continue ;; esac
                if [ -f "$j" ]; then launch="-jar $j"; break; fi
            done
        fi
    fi
fi
[ -n "$launch" ] || fail "$name's server download doesn't say how to start it, so it can't be installed."
[ "${launch#@user_jvm_args.txt}" = "$launch" ] || [ -f user_jvm_args.txt ] || [ -f /mnt/server/user_jvm_args.txt ] ||
    echo "# Extra Java arguments, one per line." > user_jvm_args.txt
# Fabric's launcher runs Minecraft's server.jar, which it would otherwise
# download unchecked on the first start.
[ "$loader" != fabric ] || vanilla server.jar
# Forge for 1.6 to 1.16 loads Minecraft's own jar from the server folder.
if [ "$loader" = forge ] && [ "${launch#-jar }" != "$launch" ] && older "$mc" 1.17 && ! older "$mc" 1.6; then
    vanilla "minecraft_server.$mc.jar"
fi
cd /mnt/server

# ---- Move the pack into place, keeping what the owner changed. ----
# .raptor-pack lists each file the last install put here, with its hash.
# A file still as the pack left it is updated or removed with the pack; a
# file someone changed is kept (mods and libraries are always the pack's),
# and worlds are never touched.
world=""
for p in server.properties "$stage/files/server.properties"; do
    [ -n "$world" ] || [ ! -f "$p" ] || world=$(sed -n 's/^level-name=//p' "$p" | tail -n1 | tr -d '\r')
done
world=${world:-world}
declare -A old=() new=()
first=1
if [ -f .raptor-pack ]; then
    first=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do old["${line:42}"]=${line:0:40}; done < .raptor-pack
fi
while IFS= read -r line; do
    new["${line:42}"]=${line:0:40}
done < <(cd "$stage/files" && find . -type f -printf '%P\0' | xargs -0 -r sha1sum)

ours() { case "$1" in mods/*|coremods/*|lib/*|libraries/*|"${launch#-jar }") return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }
added=0 updated=0 removed=0
kept=()
for rel in "${!new[@]}"; do
    src="$stage/files/$rel"
    if [ "${rel#"$world"/}" != "$rel" ]; then
        # The pack's world: only for a server that has none yet.
        unset 'new[$rel]'
        [ -f "$world/level.dat" ] || { mkdir -p "${rel%/*}"; mv -f "$src" "$rel"; }
        continue
    fi
    if [ -L "$rel" ] || [ -d "$rel" ]; then
        kept+=("$rel")
    elif [ -f "$rel" ]; then
        cur=$(sum sha1 "$rel")
        if [ "$cur" = "${new[$rel]}" ]; then
            :
        elif [ "${old[$rel]:-}" = "$cur" ] || ours "$rel"; then
            mv -f "$src" "$rel"
            updated=$((updated + 1))
        else
            kept+=("$rel")
        fi
    else
        [ "${rel%/*}" = "$rel" ] || mkdir -p "${rel%/*}"
        mv -f "$src" "$rel"
        added=$((added + 1))
    fi
done
for rel in "${!old[@]}"; do
    [ -z "${new[$rel]+x}" ] || continue
    if [ -f "$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$rel" ] && [ "$(sum sha1 "$rel")" = "${old[$rel]}" ]; then
        rm -f "$rel"
        removed=$((removed + 1))
    fi
done
# A first install over existing files (another egg's, say): mods the pack
# doesn't have would load next to its own, so they're set aside.
moved=0
if [ "$first" = 1 ]; then
    for f in mods/*.jar mods/*.zip coremods/*.jar coremods/*.zip; do
        [ -f "$f" ] && [ -z "${new[$f]+x}" ] || continue
        mkdir -p "${f%%/*}.old"
        mv -f "$f" "${f%%/*}.old/"
        moved=$((moved + 1))
    done
fi
for rel in "${!new[@]}"; do printf '%s  %s\n' "${new[$rel]}" "$rel"; done | sort -k2 > .raptor-pack.new
mv -f .raptor-pack.new .raptor-pack
# What the startup command reads: the Java it needs, and how to start it.
echo "$need $max" > .raptor-java
echo "$launch" > .raptor-launch
echo "$url" > .raptor-technic

echo
[ "$updated" = 0 ] && [ "$added" = 0 ] && [ "$removed" = 0 ] || echo "Files: $added added, $updated updated, $removed removed."
[ "$moved" = 0 ] || echo "Moved $moved mods the pack doesn't include to mods.old, so they don't load next to its own."
if [ "${#kept[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "Kept these files you changed instead of the pack's version:"
    printf '  %s\n' "${kept[@]:0:20}"
    [ "${#kept[@]}" -le 20 ] || echo "  and $((${#kept[@]} - 20)) more"
fi
java_text="Java $need"
[ -z "$max" ] || [ "$max" = "$need" ] || java_text="Java $need to $max"
[ -n "$max" ] || java_text="Java $need or newer"
with="with $Loader"
[ "$loader" != other ] || with="on its own server"
echo "Installed $name $version, for Minecraft $mc $with. It needs $java_text."

variables.name: Modpack
variables.description: The pack's name from its link on Technic's site, such as tekkit, hexxit or the-1122-pack; the whole link works too.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The pack build to install: recommended for the one Technic recommends, latest for the newest, or a build such as 1.6.6. Reinstall after changing it.
